limitations: Requires both complete-graph factors to have at least three vertices; no assertion for two-vertex factors or noncomplete factors. Possible overlap with unindexed literature remains a priority risk. Finite verification is not an infinite proof.

scientific_integrity.basis: Self-contained induced-path classification and injection-based enumerations, with a standalone brute-force finite regression verifier.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: proved over the stated infinite family by explicit canonical cases; separate finite regressions
scientific_integrity.unproved_scope: Other graph products and factors with fewer than three vertices

title: Monophonic position sets and maximality spectra of direct products of complete graphs
